cases.title: Safe division
cases.task_description: Implement safe_divide(a, b). It must return the quotient for non-zero b and raise ValueError('division by zero') when b is zero.

cases.title: Email normalization
cases.task_description: Implement normalize_email(value): trim surrounding whitespace and lowercase the email. Reject non-string and empty values with ValueError.

cases.title: Port validation
cases.task_description: Implement parse_port(value): accept integer strings and integers from 1 through 65535; reject booleans, malformed values, zero, and out-of-range values with ValueError.

cases.title: Pagination validation
cases.task_description: Implement paginate(items, limit, offset): require limit 1..100 and offset >= 0; return the requested slice. Raise ValueError for invalid bounds.

cases.title: Stable deduplication
cases.task_description: Implement unique_preserving_order(items): remove duplicates while preserving the first occurrence order. Support hashable values.

cases.title: Task status transitions
cases.task_description: Implement can_transition(current, target). Allowed transitions: pending->running/cancelled; running->succeeded/failed/cancelled; failed->pending. All others return False.

cases.title: UTC timestamp normalization
cases.task_description: Implement to_utc_iso(value): accept ISO datetime strings; treat naive timestamps as UTC; convert offset-aware timestamps to UTC; return ISO string ending in +00:00.

cases.title: Workspace path containment
cases.task_description: Implement resolve_workspace_path(root, user_path): resolve the path and ensure it remains inside root. Raise ValueError for traversal or absolute-path escape.

cases.title: Archive member validation
cases.task_description: Implement is_safe_archive_member(name): return False for absolute paths, parent traversal, Windows drive paths, or NUL bytes; True for safe relative names.

cases.title: Bounded retry
cases.task_description: Implement retry_delay(attempt, base=0.5, maximum=8.0): attempt must be >=1; return min(base * 2**(attempt-1), maximum).

cases.title: Retryable HTTP status
cases.task_description: Implement is_retryable_status(status): true only for 408, 425, 429, and 500..599; false for all other HTTP status codes.

cases.title: Atomic in-memory update
cases.task_description: Implement apply_updates(state, updates): apply updates to a copy and return it; if any key is not a string or any value is None, raise ValueError and do not mutate the original state.

cases.title: Optimistic version check
cases.task_description: Implement update_if_version(record, expected_version, changes): update and increment version only when versions match; otherwise raise ValueError. Do not mutate on conflict.

cases.title: Secret redaction
cases.task_description: Implement redact_secrets(text): redact values after case-insensitive keys api_key, token, password, secret when followed by = or :. Preserve key and separator.

cases.title: Resource ownership authorization
cases.task_description: Implement can_access(resource_owner_id, current_user_id, is_admin=False): allow owner or admin only.

cases.title: JSON-safe serialization
cases.task_description: Implement to_json_value(value): convert UUID to string, datetime to ISO string, Enum to its value, recursively handle dict/list/tuple, and leave JSON primitives unchanged.

cases.title: Empty collection average
cases.task_description: Implement safe_average(values): return None for empty input and arithmetic mean otherwise.

cases.title: Unicode-safe truncation
cases.task_description: Implement truncate_text(text, max_chars): truncate by Unicode code points, return unchanged if within limit, reject negative limits.

cases.title: Guaranteed resource cleanup
cases.task_description: Implement use_resource(resource, operation): call operation(resource), and always call resource.close() exactly once, including when operation raises; return operation result.

cases.title: Required configuration validation
cases.task_description: Implement require_config(config, required_keys): return a copy when all keys exist and have non-empty values; otherwise raise ValueError listing missing keys without printing values.
